title: Auth notifications workflow handoff
content:
Auth got a focused notifications pass today. The page now has a small set of sample triggers so it is never empty, and the owner can mute or enable notification emails one trigger at a time instead of only using one global switch.

What changed:

  • Sample triggers: added two visible example triggers so the page reads like a real notification surface before live entries arrive.
  • Per-trigger email controls: added individual on/off toggles for each notification type, keeping the master email switch while allowing selective filtering later.
  • Empty state cleanup: replaced the plain "No notifications yet" feel with guidance that the sample cards are intentionally shown first and live notifications will appear underneath them.

This is now set up the way it should behave when more sites start emitting notification events: one shared auth notification surface, with fine-grained email control per event rather than a single all-or-nothing mail toggle.
